name: Flujo Sanguíneo rPPG
description: Detecta flujo sanguíneo facial mediante fotopletismografía remota para identificar deepfakes
algorithm: Blood Flow rPPG — Sensor/Physical Model Analyzer
mechanism:
This method detects deepfakes using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) following Qi et al. (2020) and Ciftci et al. (2020):

1. **Piel Región Detección**: Face regions with visible skin are identified and tracked: forehead, cheeks, and chin areas where subcutaneous blood flow produces measurable color changes. These regions of interest (ROIs) are stabilized across frames to compensate for head motion.

2. **Pulse Señal Extracción**: Subtle color variations caused by cardiac blood flow are extracted from the green channel (highest hemoglobin absorption sensitivity). Using chrominance-based methods (CHROM) or plane-orthogonal-to-skin (POS), the pulse signal is separated from motion artifacts and illumination changes.

3. **Heart Rate Estimación**: The pulse signal's power spectral density is computed via FFT. Authentic video of living humans shows a clear spectral peak at the cardiac frequency (typically 0.75-2.5 Hz / 45-150 BPM). Deepfake videos — which don't simulate subcutaneous blood flow — lack this physiological signal or produce it only weakly and inconsistently.

4. **Espacial Coherencia Verificación**: The pulse signals from multiple facial ROIs should be temporally synchronized (blood flow reaches face regions with minor delays). The method checks cross-correlation between ROI pulse signals — per Ciftci et al. (2020), authentic faces show high inter-ROI coherence while deepfake faces show low spatial coherence of whatever pseudo-pulse signal may be present.

5. **Physiological Plausibility Puntuación**: The extracted vital signs are evaluated for physiological plausibility: heart rate within normal range, heart rate variability following expected HRV patterns, pulse amplitude proportional to skin tone, and consistent signal across the recording duration. Deepfakes fail multiple physiological criteria, yielding high detection scores.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante blood flow rppg analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Qi, H. et al. (2020). DeepRhythm: Exposing DeepFakes with Attentional Visual Heartbeat Rhythms. ACM MM.
Ciftci, U.A. et al. (2020). FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals. IEEE TPAMI.
